contacts.note: the only subprocess is the pinned official SLURP evaluate.py, which is the scorer and not a model; every token figure is the stated whitespace x 1.3 proxy and no tokenizer was called

normalized_loss_table.what_it_is: MF-9's per-type loss attribution, recomputed with the normalizer applied to gold and prediction alike, so question 4 can RE-PRICE every ceiling rung under the normalized metric rather than assert which way it would move. The per-type masses close against the corpus total, or this read raises

scorer.applies_to: gold AND prediction, before the official distance blocks

inventory.why_rejected: the corpus witnesses these leading tokens at the floor, but they carry meaning: stripping them merges `next week` with `last week`. No corpus statistic separates them from `on` and `the`, so the candidate set is declared and the corpus only confirms

scorer.on_wednesday_is_not_repaired: MF-9 section 1.4's `on wednesday` -> `wednesday` example is NOT repaired by this rule: `on` is in the declared candidate set but TRAIN never carries `on X` and `X` as fillers of the same type, so the confirmation floor refuses it at zero witnesses. The rule declines to act where the corpus gives it no evidence, and the residual is charged to the arm rather than forgiven

r3_candidate_filter_evidence.verdict: REFUSED. A metric that maps `next week`, `last week`, `this week` and `one week` onto `week` does not clarify the score, it forgives a real error. No corpus statistic separates `next` from `on`, so the candidate set is declared and the corpus only confirms
r3_candidate_filter_evidence.what_it_is: the SAME R3 rung with its declared candidate set dropped, so the token list comes from the corpus alone. This is the version this audit built first; the false-merge audit below is what refused it

scorer.reporting_rule: the paper-facing SLURP number stays the official evaluate.py one; the normalized number is reported BESIDE it, exactly as asr-wer-whisper sits beside raw asr-wer. No verdict, lock or admission in this repository is restated under it

surface_form_mass.what_it_is: MF-9's own attribution engine re-run over the SAME sealed KC-S1b rows with the normalizer applied to gold and prediction alike
